description:
Question: Can a gardener who is not confident with technology understand applying, viewing their own allocation and reporting a problem, and can the coordinator understand list-based assignment?
Artifact: A phone prototype covering these journeys, coordinator application lists and plot selectors, with large text, plain language, keyboard/focus/contrast and empty/loading/error/recovery examples.
Criteria: Owner reviews and records feedback before dependent user-interface work proceeds. Source: brief.md / Users and Constraints, owner map deferral.
Prerequisites: none. Follow-on tickets T-005, T-008 and T-009 wait on this checkpoint; server foundation stays unblocked.
Excludes: coordinator map or grid design. Assumptions: prototype may use synthetic data. Stage-1 limitation: this is an ordinary ticket; owner approval is not automatically enforced.
title: Checkpoint: phone journey prototype
